title: A web page visitor can talk the gym's AI helper into promising things the gym never wrote
what: The AI helper on a gym's web page is told to answer only from what the owner wrote and to ignore instructions typed by visitors. The check run on its answer before the visitor sees it only catches web addresses, phone numbers, rupee amounts written in digits and percentages. A visitor who tricks the AI into saying it knows can make it show made-up promises in words, such as free personal training, a ladies batch, or a price written in words, under the gym's name. The helper is switched off today.
expected: An answer that claims something not in the gym's own page words is replaced by 'I will ask the gym', and a test tries a visitor message that tells the AI to break its rules.
who: gyms with the web page AI helper on
how_often: only when a visitor tries to trick it
fix_line: Before switching the helper on, add a test with a rule-breaking visitor message and widen the answer check
